learning: Verify whether an approval is still needed, and provide the direct action link whenever claiming the user must review or act.

turns.text: The first rule is already in Instar 2.0. Its copy in the current Instar is still open for your review.
This is an INSTAR violation. Never tell the user something is open for review or waiting on them without directly providing a link to what needs them.
You already approved it at 12:25, so nothing was waiting on you. It is waiting only for its test run before it merges.

instructions: User had already approved the change.
Provide a direct link whenever user attention or approval is required.
decisions: Expected: check actual approval and test state.
Actual: inferred user action was required from the open PR state, and omitted the direct link.

note: Sanitized regression fixture derived from logged source messages; does not claim the originating defect is fixed.
